title: Seoul Apartment Prices Since January: The Rebased KB Path
html:
The question this post answers
What is the latest value of the rebased KB Seoul apartment index?
The short answer
  • The KB Seoul apartment index, rebased to January 2026 = 100, reached 109.4 in September 2026.
  • The year-on-year change was 15.04% in September 2026, up from 14.69% in August.
  • Korean and English press reported a record 87th straight weekly rise in early October.

Data as of 2026-09 · Last updated 2026-10-12 · 4 min read

The Bank of Korea's ECOS database carries a KB index of Seoul apartment prices that has been rebased so that January 2026 equals 100 [1]. That makes the year easy to read: every figure after January is simply how far above that starting line the market has moved.

In this post

  1. Before January
  2. Since January
  3. The yearly rate
  4. What the local press is saying
  5. Where to check the figures
  6. Sources

Before January

The series starts in September 2023 at 86.5. It then drifted sideways and slightly lower, bottoming at 86.08 in May 2024 [1].

The turn came in the summer of 2024. The index read 86.7 in July, 88.2 in September and 89.1 in December [1]. By January 2025 it stood at 89.2, and it was still 89.2 in February [1]. From there the climb was steadier: 90.7 in April, 92.5 in June, 95.1 in September and 98.1 in November [1].

Since January

December 2025 came in at 99.1, and January 2026 is the 100.0 base [1]. Then 102.8 in March, 105.8 in June, 108.1 in August and 109.4 in September [1].

The table below puts the monthly index next to the year-on-year rate for 2026 [1][2].

Over the latest month the index rose 1.1%, and over three months 3.4%. The six-month change is 6.4% and the twelve-month change is 15.0% [1]. Going back to September 2023, the gain is 26.4% [1].

The yearly rate

The year-on-year line tells a similar story from a different angle. It was 1.96% in September 2024 and 4.12% in March 2025 [2]. It passed 8% in July 2025 (8.15%), then eased to 7.77% in September 2025 [2].

After that it moved up again: 10.35% in November 2025, 12.15% in January 2026 and 14.46% in March [2]. It held in a narrow band through the spring and summer, from 14.07% in July to 14.74% in May, and reached 15.04% in September [2]. That is 0.35 percentage points above August's 14.69% [2].

I think the useful detail is the flat stretch in the middle of 2026. The monthly index kept rising, but the yearly rate barely moved, because the comparison months from 2025 were also rising quickly.

What the local press is saying

Headlines in early October are mostly about duration. UPI reported that Seoul apartment prices rose for a record 87th straight week [3], and the Korean outlet Newsis ran a similar report calling it the longest rising streak [4].

Korean reports also point to a split inside the city. Energy Economy reported that the weekly rise widened again while the three Gangnam districts fell and northern Seoul kept rising [5]. Weekly survey figures and this monthly index are different measures, so the two should not be read as one number.

Official data and rules

  • Korea Real Estate Board R-ONE
  • Bank of Korea (English)

Where to check the figures

The monthly series comes from the Bank of Korea's ECOS statistics system, reachable from the Bank of Korea English site [6]. The Korea Real Estate Board's R-ONE portal is the other official place to look [7].

Questions people ask

What is the latest value of the rebased KB Seoul apartment index?

It was 109.4 in September 2026, with January 2026 set to 100. That is 1.1% above the August reading of 108.1.

What was the year-on-year change in September 2026?

It was 15.04%, compared with 7.77% in September 2025 and 1.96% in September 2024.
